newsitem.title: USA: Verio Inc sells $150 mln in debt with warrants.
newsitem.headline: Verio Inc sells $150 mln in debt with warrants.

text.p: The following 144a debt issue from national internet service provider Verio Inc was priced on Tuesday via lead manager Merrill Lynch & Co Inc, according to a source close to the deal.
TYPE SENIOR NOTES ISS PRICE 100.00 FIRST PAY DATE 12/15/97 LAST MOODY'S NR YIELD 13.50 PCT PAY FREQ SEMI-ANNUAL
LAST S&P NR CALLABLE NON CALL FIVE
NOTES: priced as units with warrants for nine percent equity
: three-yr equity call for 1/3 of deal at par plus coupon

Proceeds will be used for the company's aggressive acquisition strategy and buildout of the network, according to a Verio spokesman. The company said it plans acquisitions or major investments in as many as 31 regionally managed ISPs within the next six to 12 months.
Price talk on the issue was for a 13 percent to 13-1/4 percent coupon and warrants for three percent equity.
